description: Instance-level enrichment overrides applied during convert_rdf.py. Each entry refines a baseline node's rdf:type to a more specific class introduced by the Phase 1 enrichment layer (see docs/architecture_amendment_sdkb_centric.md). The baseline node's primary type is preserved; the refined type is added as an additional rdf:type triple (justified because the refined class is a subclass of the primary type).

type_refinements.rationale: Polysilicon is polycrystalline silicon — a semiconductor material. It typically arrives intrinsic and is doped in-process; this entry uses the parent class Semiconductor rather than guessing intrinsic vs extrinsic at the instance level. A future refinement could split into IntrinsicSemiconductor / ExtrinsicSemiconductor when process context is curated.

empty_classes_note.Dopant: No baseline node represents a dopant element (boron, phosphorus, arsenic, etc.). The class is defined but unpopulated; future SDKB versions may add dopant material instances if implant/diffusion processes are modeled at finer granularity.
empty_classes_note.IntrinsicSemiconductor: Empty — baseline does not distinguish intrinsic vs extrinsic at instance level
